verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both are cramped. The fine print, the subcopy and the date/venue lines are illegibly small at this banner height. The RSVP button is no bigger than the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS badges, so it gets lost among them. The product can and the placeholder image are jammed into a dense right-hand cluster, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' now sits under the headline instead of above it. B is slightly worse because the edge of the planet circle cuts through the SOLSTICE wordmark and makes the logo harder to read, while in A the logo stays clean.
